english: Which seat became vacant after the assassination of Provincial Minister Rustam Jamali?
roman_1: Subai Wazir Rustam Jamali ke qatal ke baad kaun si nishist khaali hui?
roman_2: Rustam Jamali ke qatal ke baad subai wazir ki kaun si seat khaali hui?
